# Capability manifest for the FFmpeg builds Beamfall runs.
#
# DERIVED MACHINE OUTPUT — DO NOT HAND-EDIT. Every line inside a platform
# section is verbatim `ffmpeg -h filter=<name>` output from that build itself,
# so this file states what the build really accepts rather than what anyone
# remembers.
#
# Sections are per PLATFORM, because the pinned artifact is not one build: the
# Linux pin is per-architecture (ffmpeg.lock), and darwin has no locked artifact
# at all (ADR-0075 Amendment 2026-07-26 D5, DARWIN_FFMPEG_PIN — darwin resolves
# FFmpeg through exec.LookPath and is pinned by resolved-binary identity). A
# filter absent from a build simply has NO section entry there, which is how
# this file records that a backend is not certifiable on that platform.
#
# Recorded so far:
#   linux/arm64 — jellyfin-ffmpeg 7.1.4-Jellyfin (ffmpeg.pin 7.1.4-3), from the
#                 artifact ffmpeg.lock authenticates for that architecture.
#
# NOT yet recorded, and each absence is load-bearing rather than an oversight:
#   linux/amd64 — needs a host that can pull the linux/amd64 base image.
#   darwin/*    — needs a darwin host whose resolved FFmpeg ships
#                 tonemap_videotoolbox; no build available to this tree has it,
#                 so VideoToolbox has no verified hardware tone-map spelling and
#                 cannot be certified (ADR-0075 Amendment 2026-07-26 D1a §5).
#
# Note what the linux/arm64 record already proves: that build ships NO
# tonemap_vaapi and NO tonemap_qsv. The VAAPI and QSV chains therefore tone-map
# through tonemap_opencl on an OpenCL device derived from the VAAPI/QSV one,
# which D1a §1 names as an accepted and expected topology.
#
# Regenerate a LINUX section (reads the URL + SHA-256 from ffmpeg.lock; never
# hardcode them). Set ARCH to arm64 or amd64:
#
#   ARCH=arm64
#   L=internal/ffmpeg/ffmpeg.lock
#   U=$(sed -n "s/^FFMPEG_LINUX_$(echo $ARCH | tr a-z A-Z)_URL=//p" $L)
#   S=$(sed -n "s/^FFMPEG_LINUX_$(echo $ARCH | tr a-z A-Z)_SHA256=//p" $L)
#   docker run --rm -i --platform "linux/$ARCH" debian:bookworm-slim bash -s "$U" "$S" <<'SH'
#   set -eu
#   apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq curl ca-certificates >/dev/null
#   curl -fsSL -o /tmp/ff.deb "$1"
#   echo "$2  /tmp/ff.deb" | sha256sum -c - >/dev/null
#   apt-get install -y -qq /tmp/ff.deb >/dev/null
#   FF=/usr/lib/jellyfin-ffmpeg/ffmpeg
#   echo "=== HELP_PLATFORM_BEGIN linux/$ARCH"
#   echo "=== HELP_PLATFORM_PIN sha256=$2"
#   for f in tonemapx tonemap zscale format tonemap_vaapi tonemap_qsv \
#            tonemap_cuda tonemap_opencl tonemap_videotoolbox hwupload hwdownload; do
#     out="$($FF -hide_banner -h filter="$f" 2>&1)" || true
#     case "$out" in *"Unknown filter"*) continue ;; esac
#     echo "=== HELP_FILTER_BEGIN $f"
#     printf '%s\n' "$out"
#     echo "=== HELP_FILTER_END $f"
#   done
#   echo "=== HELP_PLATFORM_END linux/$ARCH"
#   SH
#
# A DARWIN section is generated on a darwin host from the RESOLVED binary, with
# the same loop but `FF=$(command -v ffmpeg)`, a `darwin/<arch>` platform name
# and `HELP_PLATFORM_PIN sha256=$(shasum -a 256 "$FF" | cut -d" " -f1)` — the
# same darwin binary identity D5 defines — so the section still states what the
# running build accepts.
#
# The software HDR->SDR recipe (hdrToSDRFilters) must be covered by EVERY
# section: a filter it names that a recorded build does not have is a hard test
# failure, not a pass. A HARDWARE backend whose chain filters are missing from a
# section is not a failure — it is that backend recorded as not certifiable on
# that platform, and the release gate keeps it out of the GA claim.
=== HELP_PLATFORM_BEGIN linux/arm64
=== HELP_PLATFORM_PIN sha256=9de240f98cc49db7ebc649c72c37d3ef154170d37ec2fbc68483cc84744804bb
=== HELP_FILTER_BEGIN tonemapx
Filter tonemapx
  SIMD optimized HDR to SDR tonemapping
    slice threading supported
    Inputs:
       #0: default (video)
    Outputs:
       #0: default (video)
tonemapx AVOptions:
   tonemap           <int>        ..FV....... tonemap algorithm selection (from 0 to 7) (default bt2390)
     none            0            ..FV.......
     linear          1            ..FV.......
     gamma           2            ..FV.......
     clip            3            ..FV.......
     reinhard        4            ..FV.......
     hable           5            ..FV.......
     mobius          6            ..FV.......
     bt2390          7            ..FV.......
   transfer          <int>        ..FV....... set transfer characteristic (from -1 to INT_MAX) (default bt709)
     bt709           1            ..FV.......
     bt2020          14           ..FV.......
     smpte2084       16           ..FV.......
   t                 <int>        ..FV....... set transfer characteristic (from -1 to INT_MAX) (default bt709)
     bt709           1            ..FV.......
     bt2020          14           ..FV.......
     smpte2084       16           ..FV.......
   matrix            <int>        ..FV....... set colorspace matrix (from -1 to INT_MAX) (default bt709)
     bt709           1            ..FV.......
     bt2020          9            ..FV.......
   m                 <int>        ..FV....... set colorspace matrix (from -1 to INT_MAX) (default bt709)
     bt709           1            ..FV.......
     bt2020          9            ..FV.......
   primaries         <int>        ..FV....... set color primaries (from -1 to INT_MAX) (default bt709)
     bt709           1            ..FV.......
     bt2020          9            ..FV.......
   p                 <int>        ..FV....... set color primaries (from -1 to INT_MAX) (default bt709)
     bt709           1            ..FV.......
     bt2020          9            ..FV.......
   range             <int>        ..FV....... set color range (from -1 to INT_MAX) (default -1)
     tv              1            ..FV.......
     pc              2            ..FV.......
     limited         1            ..FV.......
     full            2            ..FV.......
   r                 <int>        ..FV....... set color range (from -1 to INT_MAX) (default -1)
     tv              1            ..FV.......
     pc              2            ..FV.......
     limited         1            ..FV.......
     full            2            ..FV.......
   format            <string>     ..FV....... output format (default "same")
   param             <double>     ..FV....... tonemap parameter (from DBL_MIN to DBL_MAX) (default nan)
   desat             <double>     ..FV....... desaturation strength (from 0 to DBL_MAX) (default 0)
   peak              <double>     ..FV....... signal peak override (from 0 to DBL_MAX) (default 0)
   apply_dovi        <boolean>    ..FV....... Apply Dolby Vision metadata if possible (default true)
=== HELP_FILTER_END tonemapx

=== HELP_FILTER_BEGIN format
Filter format
  Convert the input video to one of the specified pixel formats.
    Inputs:
       #0: default (video)
    Outputs:
       #0: default (video)
(no)format AVOptions:
   pix_fmts          <string>     ..FV....... A '|'-separated list of pixel formats
   color_spaces      <string>     ..FV....... A '|'-separated list of color spaces
   color_ranges      <string>     ..FV....... A '|'-separated list of color ranges
=== HELP_FILTER_END format
=== HELP_FILTER_BEGIN tonemap_cuda
Filter tonemap_cuda
  GPU accelerated HDR to SDR tonemapping
    Inputs:
       #0: default (video)
    Outputs:
       #0: default (video)
tonemap_cuda AVOptions:
   tonemap           <int>        ..FV....... Tonemap algorithm selection (from 0 to 7) (default bt2390)
     none            0            ..FV.......
     linear          1            ..FV.......
     gamma           2            ..FV.......
     clip            3            ..FV.......
     reinhard        4            ..FV.......
     hable           5            ..FV.......
     mobius          6            ..FV.......
     bt2390          7            ..FV.......
   tonemap_mode      <int>        ..FV....... Tonemap mode selection (from 0 to 4) (default auto)
     max             0            ..FV....... Brightest channel based tonemap
     rgb             1            ..FV....... Per-channel based tonemap
     lum             2            ..FV....... Relative luminance based tonemap
     itp             3            ..FV....... ICtCp intensity based tonemap
     auto            4            ..FV....... Select based on GPU spec
   transfer          <int>        ..FV....... Set transfer characteristic (from -1 to INT_MAX) (default bt709)
     bt709           1            ..FV.......
     bt2020          14           ..FV.......
     smpte2084       16           ..FV.......
   t                 <int>        ..FV....... Set transfer characteristic (from -1 to INT_MAX) (default bt709)
     bt709           1            ..FV.......
     bt2020          14           ..FV.......
     smpte2084       16           ..FV.......
   matrix            <int>        ..FV....... Set colorspace matrix (from -1 to INT_MAX) (default bt709)
     bt709           1            ..FV.......
     bt2020          9            ..FV.......
   m                 <int>        ..FV....... Set colorspace matrix (from -1 to INT_MAX) (default bt709)
     bt709           1            ..FV.......
     bt2020          9            ..FV.......
   primaries         <int>        ..FV....... Set color primaries (from -1 to INT_MAX) (default bt709)
     bt709           1            ..FV.......
     bt2020          9            ..FV.......
   p                 <int>        ..FV....... Set color primaries (from -1 to INT_MAX) (default bt709)
     bt709           1            ..FV.......
     bt2020          9            ..FV.......
   range             <int>        ..FV....... Set color range (from -1 to INT_MAX) (default -1)
     tv              1            ..FV.......
     pc              2            ..FV.......
     limited         1            ..FV.......
     full            2            ..FV.......
   r                 <int>        ..FV....... Set color range (from -1 to INT_MAX) (default -1)
     tv              1            ..FV.......
     pc              2            ..FV.......
     limited         1            ..FV.......
     full            2            ..FV.......
   format            <string>     ..FV....... Output format (default "same")
   apply_dovi        <boolean>    ..FV....... Apply Dolby Vision metadata if possible (default true)
   tradeoff          <int>        ..FV....... Apply tradeoffs to offload computing (from -1 to 1) (default auto)
     auto            -1           ..FV.......
     disabled        0            ..FV.......
     enabled         1            ..FV.......
   peak              <double>     ..FV....... Signal peak override (from 0 to DBL_MAX) (default 0)
   param             <double>     ..FV....... Tonemap parameter (from DBL_MIN to DBL_MAX) (default nan)
   desat             <double>     ..FV....... Desaturation parameter (from 0 to DBL_MAX) (default 0)
   threshold         <double>     ..FV....... Scene detection threshold (from 0 to DBL_MAX) (default 0.2)

=== HELP_FILTER_BEGIN tonemap_opencl
Filter tonemap_opencl
  Perform HDR to SDR conversion with tonemapping.
    Inputs:
       #0: default (video)
    Outputs:
       #0: default (video)
tonemap_opencl AVOptions:
   tonemap           <int>        ..FV....... Tonemap algorithm selection (from 0 to 7) (default bt2390)
     none            0            ..FV.......
     linear          1            ..FV.......
     gamma           2            ..FV.......
     clip            3            ..FV.......
     reinhard        4            ..FV.......
     hable           5            ..FV.......
     mobius          6            ..FV.......
     bt2390          7            ..FV.......
   tonemap_mode      <int>        ..FV....... Tonemap mode selection (from 0 to 4) (default auto)
     max             0            ..FV....... Brightest channel based tonemap
     rgb             1            ..FV....... Per-channel based tonemap
     lum             2            ..FV....... Relative luminance based tonemap
     itp             3            ..FV....... ICtCp intensity based tonemap
     auto            4            ..FV....... Select the preferred mode
   transfer          <int>        ..FV....... Set transfer characteristic (from -1 to INT_MAX) (default bt709)
     bt709           1            ..FV.......
     bt2020          14           ..FV.......
     smpte2084       16           ..FV.......

     bt709           1            ..FV.......
     bt2020          9            ..FV.......

     bt709           1            ..FV.......
